meta.description: Searches for data science and related roles across UN Inspira (UN Secretariat) and unjobs.org (covers 50+ UN agencies: UNDP, UNICEF, WHO, WFP, UNHCR, etc.). Results are written to the same 'Jobs Found' Google Sheet tab used by the LinkedIn pipeline — the 'source' column tells you which portal each job came from. SETUP: (1) Same Google Sheets ID and credential as the main pipeline. (2) No API key needed for either source — both use web scraping. (3) Inspira note: if 'No Inspira results parsed' appears, the session flow may need cookies to be preserved between requests — add a 'Cookie Jar' HTTP option or log into Inspira once manually to check if the page requires login. (4) unjobs.org is more reliable as a fallback and covers all UN agencies.
